claims.claim: An international team led by Hayato Morinaga, Satoshi N. Omura and Osamu Nureki at the University of Tokyo identified active Cas12m variants that cleave DNA.

claims.supporting_quote: An international research group led by graduate student Hayato Morinaga, Assistant Professor Satoshi N.
